text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash has won many G1 races, and the autumn Tenno Sho is particularly fresh in her memory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When I tell her how radiant she looked that day, kneeling on the track after winning before her parents, she smiles bashfully.
